planner_invariant: The planner may optimize placement/order but may not weaken semantic type, consistency, selection, authority or exactness requirements declared by the operation-specific capsule.

routes.use_when: canonical ID/key or effect-critical state required
typed predicates, joins, uniqueness, min/max/filter or exact schema relations dominate
typed multi-hop/n-ary relational neighborhood or causal/associative path needed
routes.approximation: structural pruning allowed only within declared coverage

routes.validation: model/index version + source object versions; exact-anchor validation if selected result becomes fact/effect basis
index version/lag + exact source fetch for consequential claims

routes.use_when: persistent activation/salience suggests likely relevant region before explicit search
routes.validation: activation_epoch compatible with semantic_epoch; never satisfies fact/authority requirement
selection receipt binds authorized space, route versions, fusion/ranking semantics and candidate set

routes.use_when: coverage/closure/alias/consistency unknown or fast paths disagree

placement_objective: minimize latency + serialization + contention + write amplification + recovery/common-mode + device cost subject to semantic correctness, authority and operation consistency constraints
adaptive_rule: Collect per-route p50/p95/p99, cache hit, candidate recall, rebuild tax, write amplification and recovery cost; alter physical placement only by versioned policy and preserve identical logical semantics/receipts.
memory_behavior: Automatic latent/graph activation may seed the next Assembly between LLM calls; explicit memory queries remain a fallback and a validation path rather than the sole way memory enters cognition.
